name: inquiry-need-eval
location: durable private eval store (tools/eval-store; $SELLEROPS_EVAL_STORE, default ~/.sellerops/eval-store) — never a repository, never an OS temp directory; this repository holds names, hashes, counts and provenance only

label_policy.author: designer (development set — not a holdout)
label_policy.need: one independent information/action unit without which the request is unresolved; prerequisites are evidence
label_policy.precedent: only REUSABLE may prefill another conversation

S0.description: dev DB clone as used by the F5 runs — no Catalogue Bootstrap

S1.description: clone of the Catalogue Bootstrap proof DB — same seller knowledge and past answers, plus NAVER detail facts and options

S0-A.description: offline, all knowledge models OFF — InquiryNeedEvalIT

S0-B1.description: F5 ON run 1 (apr-8610b0cc) — legacy arm TSV, prefix ids, no catalogue statements

S0-B2.description: F5 ON run 2 (apr-8610b0cc) — legacy arm TSV

S1-A.description: offline, all knowledge models OFF — InquiryNeedEvalIT

S0-V2O.description: Inquiry Decision v2 + current retrieval, ORACLE planner/judge (gold needs and gold evidence sets over the production collector) — offline, no model

S0-V2M.description: Decision v2 real model (apr-c8715d20), current retrieval

S0-V2MF5.description: Decision v2 real model + F5, run 1

S0-V2MF5b.description: Decision v2 real model + F5, run 2 (stability)

S1-V2M.description: Decision v2 real model, catalogue snapshot

S1-V2MF5.description: Decision v2 real model + F5, catalogue snapshot

role: DEV/CALIBRATION — the designer wrote the labels and every v2/v2.1 choice was made looking at them; it may never be cited as a holdout or as production readiness (docs/inquiry_decision_v2_1.md §1)

calibration.description: CoverageJudge calibration (Inquiry Decision v2.1): frozen judge inputs = gold needs as the plan + the production collector's candidates, F5 OFF, captured by InquiryNeedEvalIT EVAL_DECISION=capture with no model. The files hold the customer's message and the seller's texts — outside the repository; only hashes here.

S1.db: throwaway copy of sellerops_eval_s1 (V114 applied to the copy, then dropped; the S1 clone stays at 113)

S0-ORACLE.description: gold as judge + worst-case judge for OTHER_LISTING — harness check, 0 calls, production-shaped need ids

S0-C.status: INVALID — need ids sent as gold ids (n1); unmatched verdicts scored NONE (apr-80adf54f)

smoke.description: synthetic only — committed; 3 cases (FULL+NONE, CONDITIONAL, NONE with a REUSABLE precedent and no evidence) for a strict-schema smoke of the real API

S0-A@v2.2.status: PROJECTED — recorded raw verdicts (apr-8ef649ab) re-enforced by v2.2 code, 0 calls; not an experiment result

S0-B@v2.2.status: PROJECTED — recorded raw verdicts (apr-8ef649ab) re-enforced by v2.2 code, 0 calls; not an experiment result

targeted.description: synthetic targeted calibration set (v2.2 §6): partial table / variant-dependent / related-but-different, with hard negatives, near variants and positive controls

real3-B.status: apr-96b2fa76, 9 calls, S0 capture R:dae8554d · R:ae51c7f8 · S:T6c

storage.cache: $SELLEROPS_EVAL_CACHE (default ~/.cache/sellerops-eval) — disposable; `node tools/eval-store/store.mjs restore inquiry-need-eval v1` rebuilds it and verifies every hash
storage.redaction: tools/eval-store/redaction.mjs — a file enters the store only when the gate finds nothing; frozen files are never edited (an edited file is a new version)

incident.what: the original three files lived in an OS temporary directory (the session scratchpad) and were deleted by the operating system; ORIGINAL STORAGE LOST
incident.recovered: all three rebuilt byte-identical from their recorded build steps and verified against the hashes frozen on 2026-09-19 — so they remain v1

questions.jsonl.method: mem/questions.tsv rebuilt from its recorded heredoc (sha256 4dded121… matches the hash recorded at labelling time); each question's product = the product the offline arm-A assessor resolved on a throwaway copy of the S0 clone (no model, no marketplace); freeze step re-run

needs.jsonl.method: the recorded needs.v2 draft build + the three recorded freeze edits re-run

precedents.jsonl.method: the recorded precedent-scope annotation step re-run

lost.status: LOST — only the hashes above remain; a re-run is a NEW artifact and is never cited as one of these
